about_the_game:
Immerse yoursef in the whimsical world of Asfalia with the beautiful soundtrack of Asfalia: The Cranky Volcano.

What's included?

  • 28 tracks for over 30 minutes of original music 

  • High quality audio files (MP3 and FLAC)

  • Files properly tagged with album cover, artist names, and a description of where the musics appears in the game

  • A pdf booklet with the track list and 10 Asfalia Mandalas and Colourings
